description: Moderna, Inc. is a pioneer and leader in the field of mRNA medicine, and through the advancement of its technology platform it is reimagining how medicines are made to transform how it treats and prevents diseases, with its mRNA platform having enabled the development of vaccine and therapeutic candidates across infectious disease, oncology, rare disease and more since its founding. With a global team and a unique culture, driven by its values and mindsets, its mission is to deliver the greatest possible impact to people through mRNA medicines. It currently has three commercial products, Spikevax and mNEXSPIKE, its COVID vaccines, and mRESVIA, its vaccine against respiratory syncytial virus, with mNEXSPIKE, launched commercially in the third quarter of 2025, now its leading product in the U.S. retail channel, and in 2025 it achieved total revenue of $1.9 billion, largely from sales of its COVID vaccines.
